# RTF hidden text and structural table marks

The sources are authored for this repository, not user documents. `before.json` preserves 72 exact original RTF strings, hashes, unmodified baseline reader text and Writer/Chrome visible text and cells. `expanded-before.json` retains 48 further sources, independent expected cell sequences, baseline text, exact Writer HTML and its hash. Never replace historical baseline output with candidate output.

The first generator combines six bodies (plain, Unicode, field result, visible island, two Unicode-fallback controls), four boundary visibility patterns and three containers (paragraph, table, nested table). The expanded generator in `tests/helpers/rtf-hidden-boundaries.js` combines eight cell/row shapes, two nesting levels and direct/character-style/field-result formatting. Ten additional isolation controls protect hidden inline whitespace, metadata, skipped alternatives and Unicode fallback. Deterministic generation uses no random seed.

Native reference: LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0, build 2c87e51eeaa2b413ff4ae097b2705eea1995d8e5, actual RTF import to untouched HTML then Chrome rendering. Reproduce with `node scripts/probe-rtf-hidden-boundaries.js OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`; add `--expanded` for expanded sources. Use a new output directory to preserve the original evidence. `RTF_LIBREOFFICE` and `HTML_READER_CHROME` can select installed independent tools.

The original native run exposes 24 Unicode-fallback reference errors; RTF1.9.1 pp14-15 counts a control word as one fallback token and stops skipping at braces. The reader follows those rules. Twelve separate hidden-paragraph differences remain recorded; this patch does not settle that application policy. In the expanded native HTML, two empty middle cells in character-style mode contain an empty p/br, whose innerText is one layout newline. The raw strings remain retained; the browser verifies those cells remain empty and in position, without erasing arbitrary whitespace.

`node --test tests/rtf-hidden-boundaries.test.js` checks all source/hash contracts, 130 actual host opens, broken/stale read recovery, footnote/endnote anchors and hidden-note isolation. `npm run verify:rtf-hidden-boundaries` verifies 130 actual host-rendered trees in Chrome, including 48 direct comparisons to retained native HTML cell sequences. Supply `--baseline-ref reference snapshot` after a separate output directory to inspect old runtime behavior without modifying product files.

Source rules: [Microsoft RTF1.9.1](https://officeprotocoldoc.z19.web.core.windows.net/files/Archive_References/%5BMSFT-RTF%5D.pdf), pp14-15,93-96,133. Table marks separate cells and rows; hidden character formatting does not remove the structure. The reader still displays text and tab/newline separation, not full cell geometry, borders, merged cells or original pagination. WeChat WXML and physical devices were not run. No release version assigned yet.
